prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [140].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 140 格的答案。

options.text: Move both feet to the next shoe length before you record either of the forms.
options.zh: 先把左右鞋都換到下一個鞋長，再記下其中任何一隻的鞋楦。
options.whyZh: 前句規定測更長的左鞋時先不要再改右鞋；兩腳一起換鞋長會改掉控制的右側搭配。

options.text: Enter the form and insole used for the final trial on each side rather than copying the newer left-side entry into both fields.
options.zh: 按最後試穿結果分別記下左右鞋的鞋楦和鞋墊，不要把左腳較新的紀錄複製到兩欄。
options.whyZh: 每腳可各自試不同搭配，紀錄也要能支援分開下訂。只改左腳時，右腳不能沿用左腳的新資料。

options.text: Use the left shoe to confirm the overall size, and omit information about the right side until the order is shipped.
options.zh: 只用左鞋確認整雙尺寸，等鞋寄出後再補右腳資料。
options.whyZh: 這張卡要求每隻都註明鞋楦；出貨以後才補右側資料，製鞋人員便無從依右側結果製作。

options.text: Remove the thinner insole from both shoes before checking whether the dancer prefers the new fit.
options.zh: 先把兩鞋的薄鞋墊取出，再確認舞者是否喜歡新的搭配。
options.whyZh: 取掉兩邊薄鞋墊等於再改動原有測試設定，也沒說明如何在卡上保留左右各自的搭配結果。

explanationZh: 每腳可各自試不同搭配，紀錄也要能支援分開下訂。只改左腳時，右腳不能沿用左腳的新資料。
evidence: test the next left shoe length without making another change to the right shoe / The two sides can be ordered with different combinations

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: test the next left shoe length without making another change to the right shoe
The two sides can be ordered with different combinations
